pages.quiz:
COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.
   B. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   C. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

4. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   D. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   D. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

7. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.

8. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   C. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   C. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Action Research as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to Action Research never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   B. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Implementing an Intervention 4.0 Social and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Problem identification and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Designing and Implementing an Intervention and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Social Entrepreneurship 4.2 Opportunity Identification 4.3 Socia and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. C — Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain symbols used on a map

4. D — Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Nairobi

7. B — Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Introduction to Action Research with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Plan income and spending wisely

12. B — Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Implementing an Intervention 4.0 Social; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Problem identification; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Designing and Implementing an Intervention; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Social Entrepreneurship 4.2 Opportunity Identification 4.3 Socia; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
